verification.browser: Synthetic command fixture: confirm pronunciation, undo, pause/save, queue navigation, save-error recovery/discard; no observed browser errors after fixture mount.
verification.browserScreenshot: Local temporary artifact transcribe-memory-ui-save-recovery.png; visually inspected.

limitations: No acoustic accent adaptation or model training.
Intent labels and repeated cleanup examples are authored simulations; unchanged cleanup wording does not prove style benefit.
The prior Cohere duration_token_limit failure is not claimed fixed by application-memory changes.
Eight-worker app cap is not a verified NeMo internal thread setting; no continuous thermal trace.
The CPU selection in an optional test and additional cleanup assertion checks were added after the measured release binaries were built; inference behavior was unchanged.
